Draws mid-quickdraw as a sunburned sheriff minifig clears leather at a dusty brick crossroads, revolver-element already leveled, the outlaw opposite mid-pull with a surprised-print face, a trans-white smoke-puff bursting from the first muzzle, townsfolk diving behind a barrel-stack.

Throws a lasso mid-cast as a mounted cowboy minifig swings a rope-element loop wide toward a breakaway brick steer, the coil frozen mid-air, a second rider leaning hard from the saddle to cut off the escape, tan dust-plates scattering.

Leaps mid-train-car as an outlaw minifig springs the gap between two brick boxcars, coat-tail angled back, a strongbox visible through the open sliding-door, a railroad-guard on the roof mid-lunge with baton-element swinging to block the landing.

Pans for gold mid-swirl as a grizzled prospector minifig crouches at a trans-blue creek-edge tilting a round gold-pan, tiny gold round-plates glinting inside, a loaded mule-build behind, a fresh claim-stake hammered into the tan riverbank-plate.

Brawls mid-saloon-fight as two minifigs crash across a card-table scattering chip-tiles and bottle-elements, a wooden chair-build mid-arc above one determined-print face, the piano-player crouching behind the keys, three onlookers flattening against the bar.

Reins mid-stagecoach-haul as a driver minifig stands braced on the box hauling team-reins back hard, the brick stagecoach canting on a tight mountain turn, the shotgun-guard beside aiming a blunderbuss-element rearward, Technic-wheels kicking a dust-plate cloud.

Cracks mid-vault as a bank-robber minifig presses a dynamite-element charge against a brick vault-door, the fuse-piece arcing, a partner at the teller-window with revolver up covering the street, money-bag builds already stacked behind the counter.

Nails mid-poster as a sheriff minifig hammers a WANTED printed-tile to a jailhouse post, a deputy mid-point at the outlaw face on the tile with a surprised-print expression, a hitched horse-build shifting at the rail behind them.

Rears mid-canyon-edge as a cowboy minifig on a brick-built horse pulls it up onto two hind-hooves at a red-plate cliff rim, hat brick-held aloft, the longhorn herd thundering past below on the flat tan-plate plain, dust-plates rising.

Pushes mid-ore-cart as two miner minifigs heave a loaded brick mine-cart along Technic-rail tracks out of a shaft-arch, headlamp-elements glowing yellow, a third minifig mid-lean stabilizing a tipping pile of dark-ore-plates before it spills.

Defends mid-fort-gate as two cavalry minifigs shoulder a heavy brick gate-panel shut, one dropping an iron bar-element into the bracket, another on the parapet above aiming a rifle-element outward, the bugler minifig mid-breath on the horn-piece.

Swings mid-saloon-doors as a returning outlaw minifig hits the batwing-plate doors open with both C-hands, sending two card-players toppling backward off their stools, chips flying across the brick floor, the bartender already dropping below the counter.

Charges mid-cavalry-ride as three cavalry minifigs on brick horses surge across a tan-plate plain in a wedge, sabers angled forward, the lead trooper's determined-print face ahead of the V, a supply-wagon-build visible at the far edge pulling clear.

Aims mid-rooftop as a sharpshooter minifig goes prone on a brick false-front rooftop, rifle-element braced on the parapet-edge, target a fleeing outlaw below mid-sprint knocking over a barrel-stack, a deputy on the street pointing up to signal the angle.

Hauls mid-telegraph-wire as a railroad-crew minifig climbs a brick telegraph-pole mid-rung, wire-element strung to the crossbar, a second crew minifig on the ground mid-pull tensioning the line, the locomotive-build steaming on the track behind them.

Rolls mid-stagecoach-robbery as an outlaw minifig drops from a rocky-plate overhang onto the stagecoach roof, knees bent absorbing the landing, the driver reining back in alarm, a passenger-minifig inside mid-reach for a hidden revolver-element under the seat.

Digs mid-claim-stake as a prospector minifig drives a pick-element into hard-plate rock at a hillside-build, sparks implied by a trans-yellow stud at the impact point, a rival minifig mid-scramble up the slope behind racing to stake the same vein.

Fires mid-ambush as an outlaw minifig crouches behind a red-rock-plate boulder, revolver-element aimed at a passing gold-shipment wagon-build, the driver mid-duck, a Wells Fargo guard on the box swinging a shotgun-element around toward the muzzle-flash stud.

Herds mid-drive as a trail-boss minifig on horseback cuts left in front of a brick longhorn-build, horse body angled hard, a second cowboy closing from the right with a coiled rope, the herd funneling toward a brick loading-pen gate.

Brands mid-roundup as a cowboy minifig kneels over a brick-built calf pressing a brand-element while a second holds the rope taut, the campfire-build glowing trans-orange behind, a chuck-wagon-build open at the side with coffee-pot elements on the grate.

Escapes mid-jailbreak as an outlaw minifig squeezes through a gap in a brick jail-wall where a cell-bar-element has been pried loose, one leg through, the other pushing off the cot-build, a lantern-element swinging on its hook above the empty bunk.

Mounts mid-pursuit as a sheriff minifig swings up onto a brick horse from a running start, one C-hand gripping the saddle-stud, the other clutching a rifle-element, the saddlebag-piece flapping, a fresh set of hoofprint-studs leading out of town ahead.

Steadies mid-dynamite-fuse as a railroad-crew minifig crouches at a cliff-face draping a fuse-element into a drill-hole, a second minifig mid-sprint away arms wide herding bystanders back, the locomotive-build halted on the track waiting for the path to clear.

Confronts mid-standoff as a sheriff minifig levels a double-barrel rifle-element across a saloon bar at a cornered outlaw whose C-hands are half-raised, a deputy mid-step through the back door, the frozen tense-print expressions holding the scene on a knife-edge.

Scrambles mid-gold-rush as three prospector minifigs converge on the same creek-bend from different angles, picks and pan-elements raised, one already splashing into the trans-blue water-plate, a mule-build braying mid-rear behind the closest as the claim-race locks into a freeze.
